text:
cheng: Uploading an nsys bundle for the kv-cache perf regression. Where should I drop it? It contains a couple of customer request IDs and some raw headers — need to redact first.

sara: Upload cleaned bundles to gs://ri-perf-bundles/eng-runtime/incoming/ for now. We have an ingest lambda that picks from there. Run the scrub script before uploading.

ryan: If you want SRE/QA to pick it up fast, add the ticket link and then ping @perf-bot after upload so it gets indexed into the trace dashboard.

maria: Quick scrub steps I use:
```bash
python tools/scrub_trace.py --remove-uuids --strip-headers --mask-ips trace.nsys-rep -o trace.nsys.reduced
gzip trace.nsys.reduced
```
Also include any nsys metadata JSON that gets generated.

cheng: Example command I ran to collect the trace:
```bash
nsys profile --trace=cuda,osrt --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi --output=kv_regress_20260318 \
  --sample=cpu --force-overwrite --stdout capture.txt -- python infra/bench/run_inference.py --model rwlm-7b --batch 8
```
Will scrub then upload.

sara: Naming convention to follow (required):
eng-runtime_<short-issue>_<model>_<yyyymmdd>_<short-hash>.nsys.gz
Example: eng-runtime_kvcache-regen_rwlm7b_20260318_3f1a.nsys.gz

ryan: If bundle contains any customer IDs, also open a sec-redact ticket and link it in the README so Security can audit the redact process.

perf-bot: Please include a README.txt alongside the bundle with: reproduce steps, exact command line, model version, batch sizes, runtime flags, and a pointer to the test dataset (if allowed). Ingest requires the README.

maria: For kernel-selection debugging, attach:
- kvcache_events.log
- runtime flags file (runtime_flags.json)
- kernel-selection trace snippet (kernel_timeline.perfetto)
We prefer a small perfetto .perf for quick view plus the full nsys bundle for deep analysis.

cheng: Important: do NOT upload raw customer prompts or unredacted pickle files. If you need to include training/prompts for reproduction, put them in secure-share and reference the path in README.

sara: I'll update the internal doc (confluence: /pages/eng-runtime/perf-ingest) with the bucket path and scrub script examples. :thumbsup:

ryan: One more operational note — if you see weird kernel hotspots after scrub, include a small MPROF/KPIs table in the README (tokens/sec, avg latency, p99) so we can triage quicker.

cheng: Uploading now, will ping @perf-bot when done and link the ticket. Thanks everyone.
